question: The radius of a circular embankment is 30 meters. A drainage system is placed along a circle with a radius that is 10 meters smaller than the embankment. What is the radius of the drainage circle?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Radius of circular embankment = 30 m

Drainage circle radius is 10 m smaller than embankment.

Radius of drainage circle = 30 m − 10 m

Radius of drainage circle = 20 m

**∴ Answer = 20 m**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of the outer circular embankment (R) = 30 m

Difference between radii = 10 m

**Formula used:**

Radius of inner drainage circle (r) = Radius of embankment (R) − Reduction amount

 
• 
• Center R = 30m r = 20m Drainage Radius = 30 − 10 = 20 m 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Radius of the outer embankment (R) = 30 m

⇒ Reduction in radius for drainage system = 10 m

⇒ Radius of drainage circle (r) = 30 − 10

⇒ r = 20 m

**∴ The correct answer is (1) 20 m.**
